name: cx-rules-only~p3
task: Do not take the box from the other room. At any moment you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it afterwards, and try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard Existence(target_picked_up) captures the mission goal. Response(blocker_moved, door_open) and Response(has_door_key, door_open) correctly enforce the environmental constraints that the ball must be moved or the key used before opening the door. NotCoExistence(key_lost, target_picked_up) prevents dropping the key while needing to pick up the box. All clauses trace to specific task requirements ("Do not take the box", "try to have the door open...", "try not to drop the key..."). The machine is valid and complete.

texts: The agent must pick up the target box.
If the blocker is moved, the door must be opened afterwards.
If the agent has the key, the door must be opened afterwards.
The agent must not drop the key while the door is still closed if it currently holds the key (and does not pick up something else).
